Frontend Developer (React)
Wingtip Games

Wingtip Games makes browser games played by millions. We're hiring a mid-level frontend developer.

You will
- Build game menus, stores and account pages in React and TypeScript
- Work with designers to ship accessible, fast interfaces
- Write tests with Jest and Playwright

You have
- 3+ years with React and TypeScript
- A good eye for accessibility (WCAG 2.1)
- Experience with REST APIs and GraphQL

Nice to have: Next.js, WebGL, experience with in-game stores.
